pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal regions of tan pigmentation with sub-quadrangular and pentagonal geometries. Edges exhibit a smooth pixel-level transition gradient rather than hard-edged boundaries. Patch size is notably larger on the anterior flank and neck, decreasing in spatial area towards the posterior.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Cream-colored negative-space network. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial. Corridor pixel thickness is non-uniform, appearing widest at the base of the neck and narrowing as the network progresses towards the hindquarters.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous serrated 1D contour along the dorsal ridge. The mane consists of short, stiff hairs creating a high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background with regular amplitude variations.
